**MPC TOOLS 1.5.11**

- **HAKAI fix for the Remote tab.** On HAKAI firmware, MPC TOOLS now applies the workaround from [mpc-addin-remote issue #7](https://github.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-remote/issues/7) itself: it copies `/usr/bin/az01-launch-MPC` to `/data/mpc-addins/az01-launch-MPC-addins`, adds the Remote/File Browser/Skipback addins to that copy's `LD_PRELOAD`, and starts the MPC app through it. The Remote tab should now connect on HAKAI instead of reporting that the addins are running but refusing the connection. Nothing on the MPC is changed for good.

- **Windows:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.11-windows-x64.exe`

- **Mac:** `MPC-TOOLS-1.5.11-mac.zip` (not yet tested on a real Mac. On first open use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway)

- `SHA256SUMS` to check the files
